  PROBLEM: `asf_verify` runs `yamllint -s -d default` (line 387), so it ignores the repository's tracked `.yamllint.yml`, while CI's bare `yamllint -s` (.github/workflows/ci.yml:392) uses it; the comment at 378-380 wrongly says "the repository has no yamllint config".
  WHY: Default rules with `-s` turn line-length, document-start and truthy findings into failures that CI accepts, so any self-fix that edits an existing workflow, action or template YAML hits `_asf_fail verify failed yamllint`, no PR opens and the run escalates. It fails closed, but the self-fix cannot deliver workflow fixes. Reviewers that stated a severity said MAJOR; gemini stated none for this finding.
